title: Diwan
desc: A cook falls in love with a wealthy man's daughter. However, after receiving her father's disparaging remarks, he embraces the challenge to amass a fortune within a year.

title: Thambi Vettothi Sundaram
desc: Sundaram is brought up in a town where every educated person is involved in some kind of illegal business. However, he refuses to follow the same path and finds solace in the company of Aala.

title: Oru Kaidhiyin Diary
desc: David, a politically active person, is married to Rosy. However, when his political idol, mistreats his wife, he vows to take revenge.

title: Sevvel
desc: Sevvel, the son of a falsely convicted man, works hard and becomes a lawyer. He strives to use his knowledge and tries to help his father get justice.

title: Alexander
desc: CBI officer Alexander investigates a complex case involving murder, smuggling and political corruption. However, his search leads him to a dangerous game of cat and mouse with powerful adversaries.
